instruction: Configure LibreOffice Writer to use 1-inch margins on all sides as default.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting all margins to 1 inch (2540 hundredths of mm). Evaluator checks all four margin values. Multi-parameter verification. 1 inch = 25.4mm = 2540 in hundredths.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly reads LibreOffice configuration file that stores default margin settings
All four margin requirements are verified (LeftMargin, RightMargin, TopMargin, BottomMargin)
Expected values are correct: 2540 hundredths of mm equals 1 inch (25.4mm)
Appropriate use of check_list metric with regex patterns for XML configuration file
Proper data flow: command output -> cache file -> getter retrieves -> metric searches patterns
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Regex patterns use .* which could theoretically match across lines, but this is acceptable for the XML structure and unlikely to cause issues in practice
